da-non-sequitur.evidence: Determinant (-1)^n on V_(2,1) and the characteristic-polynomial argument follow; the explicit model and trace are proved in Lean (unitMod_braid, borromean_trace_standard).

Full review 2026-11-21. The main argument still holds: det = (-1)^n on V_(2,1), char poly lambda^2 - chi lambda + 1, unit modulus iff chi real and |chi|<=2, counterexample sigma_1^2; I re-checked with sympy that the explicit model satisfies the braid relation, that sigma_2 - h is the inverse, and that tr (sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1})^3 equals the statement's closed form (values 1.99419 at q0, -1573/64 at q=2, chi(sigma_1 sigma_2) = -1); Lean unitMod_braid / borromean_trace_standard (lean/QOU/BraidsAndKnots/UnitModulusEigenvalue.lean:122,150). Regression introduced by the diff: the rewritten 'Note that' sentence (after the Values table) states chi_(2,1)(beta_Bor) = 2 - h^4. That is false: sympy gives closed form - (2 - h^4) = -q^6+4q^4-7q^2+8-7q^-2+4q^-4-q^-6 != 0, while closed form = 2 - 3h^4 - h^6 exactly. It also asserts 'non-degenerate complex-conjugate eigenvalues', which the same block's table contradicts at q=2 (real, off the circle). The sentence is not used by the argument, so the proof still establishes the statement, but it is a false claim in the proof block. Fix: 2 - 3h^4 - h^6, and 'complex-conjugate near q0'. No owner-ruling conflict.

Full read of the proof at 1fc598b8a7. The argument holds: det rho_(2,1)(beta) = (-1)^n on V_(2,1), so even words give lambda^2 - chi*lambda + 1, unit modulus iff chi real with |chi| <= 2, and sigma_1^2 is the stated counterexample. The regression the previous entry flagged is fixed by this PR: the closing sentence now gives chi_(2,1)(beta_Bor) = 2 - 3h^4 - h^6 and restricts the complex-conjugate claim to q0 (fails at q = 2). Re-checked with sympy in an independent 2-dim model T1 = [[q,0],[1,-1/q]], T2 = [[-1/q,1],[0,q]] (braid relation verified): tr (T1 T2^{-1})^3 - (2 - 3h^4 - h^6) = 0 identically; values 1.99419 at q = 1.10998 and -1573/64 at q = 2; tr(T1 T2) = -1. No owner-ruling conflict.

trap-superlative.evidence: The proof rests on a false parenthetical, and two table entries disagree with the corpus's own closed form. (1) FALSE PARENTHETICAL: "Combined with
trap-superlative.notes: tr| <= 2 (which holds for real traces of 2x2 matrices with unit determinant)". It does not hold - diag(2, 1/2) is a real 2x2 matrix of determinant 1 and trace 2.5 - and the failure is realised inside this very setting: sigma_1^2 has determinant 1 and trace q^2 + q^-2 = 2.043706209 at the proton pin. |tr| <= 2 is exactly the hypothesis the argument needs and the one it does not establish. (2) SIGN ERROR ON THE BORROMEAN CHARACTER: the proof asserts chi_{(2,1)}(beta_Bor) = -2 and concludes lambda^2 + 2 lambda + 1 = 0, lambda = -1 degenerate. The corpus's own canonical closed form, in borromean-markov-trace-closed-form.md and cross-checked by computations/borromean_chi_independent_crosscheck.py, is chi^{(2,1)}(beta_Bor) = 2 - 3h^4 - h^6 = (-q^12 + 3q^10 - 3q^8 + 4q^6 - 3q^4 + 3q^2 - 1)/q^6. I built the 2-dimensional H_3(q) representation independently and it reproduces that closed form to 20 digits at q = 1.0, 1.07, 1.1099785827513808 and 1.5. Its value at the proton pin is +1.9941858130, so the characteristic polynomial is lambda^2 - 1.99419 lambda + 1, the eigenvalues are exp(+-i * 4.36991 degrees), and there is no degenerate -1. A sanity check confirms the sign: at q = 1 the word (sigma_1 sigma_2^-1)^3 is the identity permutation in S_3, whose standard character is +2, and 2 - 3h^4 - h^6 -> 2 as q -> 1. (3) THETA_L IS 120 DEGREES, NOT 59: the table's row "L_+ = sigma_1 sigma_2" gives theta_L approx 59 deg, but tr_{(2,1)}(sigma_1 sigma_2) = -1 EXACTLY, independent of q (I checked at all four q above), so theta_L = 120 deg exactly. That row also calls sigma_1 sigma_2 "the Hopf link"; its closure in B_3 is a one-component link, since the underlying permutation is a 3-cycle, whereas the Hopf link has two components and is the closure of sigma_1^2 in B_2. (4) The meson row cannot be checked at all: the operator M_+ is never defined in the block. I tried the two natural 6-crossing positive candidates - (sigma_1 sigma_2)^3 gives trace exactly 2 and the degenerate real eigenvalue 1, and sigma_1^3 sigma_2^3 gives 117.087 deg - and neither is the stated 54 deg. (5) CONSEQUENCE: the whole "baryon-meson duality" section is built on theta = pi for baryons, i.e. on finding (2). And the Lean sibling's theorem borromean_eigenvalue_neg_one takes tr = -2 as an explicit HYPOTHESIS - its docstring says the rep-theory input is "carried as a hypothesis, not asserted here" - so the Lean is a valid conditional whose antecedent this finding contradicts. That is the conditional-proved-is-not-premise-established pattern, with the premise now measurably false.|Reported, not edited (all mathematical, and (2) needs a decision the author should make). Route: prove or hypothesise |tr| <= 2 rather than asserting it; reconcile the Borromean character against borromean-markov-trace-closed-form.md and its cross-check script, which agree with each other and with an independent build; recompute theta_L and theta_M and define M_+; then revisit the duality section, which currently reads cos(theta) = -1 for baryons where the corpus's closed form gives cos(theta) = +0.997.
